nativeModel.positiveSpan: Processing a cell increases the table model height when the positive rowspan reaches beyond its current height. A row group can therefore contain implied rows beyond its explicit tr elements.
nativeModel.zeroSpan: A zero rowspan grows downward to the end of its own row group. It is not an instruction to use the explicit row count of the entire table.
nativeModel.groupBoundary: One cell cannot span multiple row groups. Explicit thead, tbody and tfoot require group-aware semantics.
nativeModel.clamp: The numeric content-attribute limit for rowspan is 65534. There is no general rule replacing a positive rowspan with the number of explicit source rows remaining.

automaticContract: Retain the original numeric span. A syntactically complete regular source grid, with the overflowing span capped by the checker itself, does not independently prove equivalence.

integration.otherUses: The v272 missing-quote guard reads tableSpanRepairs to refuse an uncertain compound candidate. Keep that read-only refusal guard. v272 inventories and v213 joint repairs select only tableHeaderScopes, not numeric span writes.
